question.:question/problem:
$$
f(t,z)=⟨\text{_____},\,3 \sin{\left(t \right)},\,z⟩
$$

The vector-valued function $f(t,z)$ above parametrizes the elliptic cylinder defined in Cartesian coordinates as $9x^{2}+25y^{2}=225.$ What is the first component of $f?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Recall that the ellipse $9x^{2}+25y^{2}=225$, or equivalently $\frac{x^{2}}{25}+\frac{y^{2}}{9}=1$, in the $xy$-plane has the parametrization

$$
⟨x,y⟩=⟨5 \cos{\left(t \right)},\,3 \sin{\left(t \right)}⟩,\quad t\in[0,2\pi),
$$

since

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{x^2}{25}+\frac{y^2}{9}&=\frac{(5 \cos{\left(t \right)})^2}{25}+\frac{(3 \sin{\left(t \right)})^2}{9}\\&=\cos^2 t+\sin^2 t\\&=1.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, for any point $(x,y,z)$ on our surface, we obtain the following:

$$
f(t,z)=⟨x,y,z⟩=⟨5 \cos{\left(t \right)},\,3 \sin{\left(t \right)},\,z⟩
$$

where $t\in[0,2\pi)$ and $z\in(-\infty,\infty)$.

Therefore, the first component of $f$ is $5 \cos{\left(t \right)}$.
